content.description: Every ticket and every email is read and answered by a person, at any hour of any day.

points.title: Any hour, any day
points.text: Start a live chat, open a ticket or email support@dronahost.com whenever you need help. The support policy explains how it works.

points.title: One desk for everything
points.text: Hosting, domain and email questions reach the same people, so you never explain your setup twice.

points.title: Answers in writing
points.text: Every reply arrives in writing, so you keep a record of what was checked and what was changed.

visual.question: My contact form stopped sending emails after the move. Can you help?
visual.answer: Yes. Your form needs a sending service. We checked your site and listed the three settings to add.
visual.caption: Illustration of a support ticket answered in writing
